sourceNotes: These are historical publication samples, not new validation of the release. The PR says verifications 1–4 met every criterion while the release notes say VER-004 failed criterion 2. The progressive-polish paragraph labels 0.35.1 as skeleton; component metadata distinguishes skeleton 0.57.1 and harness host 0.35.1. Each record retains its published source and the comparison judges preservation within each surface.
